integrity: The all-dimensional proof is analytical and self-contained; finite exact-rational computations corroborate sampled cases only. Source attribution and operator normalization are explicit. No independent scientific assessment has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact norm is for the specified first-chaos orthogonal projection on a finite independent Bernoulli product and is not the minimum projection constant. No claim about dependent coordinates or higher chaos; potential earlier ANOVA/Hoeffding-equivalent literature remains an originality risk.
title: A rare-corner law for first-chaos projections on biased Boolean products
